name: Soyuz TM-2
about: Soyuz TM-2 (1987-013A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1987 Feb  5. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1987 Mar  9), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
